title: Monster Force
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 1100005260 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Action. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Top-down action with Frankenstein, Wolfman, Dracula's kin heroes.
widgets.label: How it plays

widgets.text: Charge shots (hold the fire button) hit hardest; bosses open up after their attack runs. Relics found in levels raise max health.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Health pickups, relics (permanent upgrades to health and attack), switches that open the way.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: Relics hidden in each level; the score screen ranks time and play.
